notes.after: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ,
Therefore prepare your minds for action.
notes.text: literally, “gird up the waist of your mind” or “put on the belt of the waist of your mind”

notes.after: e it is contained in Scripture, “Behold,
notes.text: “Behold”, from “ הִנֵּה” or “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.
